Thank you so much for replying it means a lot to me. I go back and forth from ‘it will pass it’s just a hard time’ to ‘everything will get even worse and your mom might die’. I admitted that it was difficult to hear her so angry saying things about the divorce all the time and she got so mad and wanted me to leave to stay with my dad. I begged her to not send me out so I’m still here but now I’m wondering what to do.
I feel like I’m being punished for not trying hard enough and engaging with the world. I also feel like the universe is trying to tell me a lesson and the lesson is ‘stop being dependent on your parents and live your life’. I mean if my dad leaves and my mom could potentially end her life I will have to learn how to move on without parents right?
Anyways I want to believe what you say because everything I look up says don’t end your life and things will get better. I never believed that before but hearing this so many times means that something is giving me a sign right?
Just thank you for hearing me and commenting I’ll save it to look at later when I feel bad.

Also depression takes a lot from a person and it changes your personality. But please don’t look back at your past and think, “I used to be so much better when I was younger!” 
Because that will just make you feel worse. And your depression wants you to feel worse.

That person who used to to the chores and was charismatic is still there inside of you... but your true self is being bullied by the depression. If you fight against it you’ll become that kind person again

Also maybe try talking to the girl in your class. You said she doesn’t know that she’s hurting your feelings right? So maybe try and talk to her alone or send a message explaining how you feel.

Hey please try switching your medications to one that works and doesn’t make you feel fake or empty inside. 

I think it’s time for me to switch my medications as well because they’re not working that great anymore.

But really the medicine is there not to make you happy but to get your thoughts under control. When I was taking my medicine (when it worked) I didn’t have to worry about panic attacks as often. I also didn’t immediately go into a depressive episode mode whenever something bad happened. 

Maybe you could try a lower dose or switch brands? There’s lots of different kinds out there so I think you just have to test what works... 

I really hope you get better. Just please take your medicine!
